title: "I'm an Empath" (and Other Lies We Tell Ourselves to Avoid Boundaries)
author: Deirdre Kuvaas, LPCC
description: Fawning is the trauma response nobody talks about because society rewards it. Discover how EMDR and CPT can help you stop reading the room and start living in it.

title: The Big Myth: Do I Have to Talk About Trauma to Heal It?
author: Deirdre Kuvaas, LPCC
description: You don't have to relive it to release it. Learn why evidence-based trauma therapy focuses on healing foundational beliefs rather than recounting specific details.

title: Your People-Pleasing Side Hustle is Actually Trauma's Full-Time Job
author: Deirdre Kuvaas, LPCC
description: Chronic people-pleasing often shows up as physical pain, IBS, or constant anxiety. This isn't a personality trait — it's a learned trauma response you can break.
